notes: cics-crucible ghost-tasks / gt-post-wait-event (Apache-2.0 corpus, owner OK 2026-10-31 for the ladder, #6072): POST and WAIT EVENT: a timer-event control area zero until a WAIT EVENT posts it (X'40' first byte, X'80' third), CANCEL of the expired POST NOTFND, WAIT EVENT on a null pointer INVREQ RESP2 2, POST TIME already past EXPIRED; terminal CONVERSE with a reply that fits and one that is cut (LENGERR). Scenarios restate the crucible's terminal steps; the oracle is GnuCOBOL plus the stub, not the crucible's hand-written logs.

scenarios.name: post-wait-cancel
scenarios.why: POST AFTER SECONDS(5) REQID SET: the area is binary zeros; WAIT EVENT ECADDR returns NORMAL and the area is posted; CANCEL of the POST's REQID is NOTFND (the request expired)

scenarios.name: wait-null
scenarios.why: WAIT EVENT ECADDR on a null pointer: INVREQ, RESP2 2

scenarios.name: converse-fits
scenarios.why: CONVERSE FROM 8 bytes, TOLENGTH 10, a 5-byte reply: NORMAL, TOLENGTH 5

scenarios.name: converse-cut
scenarios.why: CONVERSE with TOLENGTH 4 and an 8-byte reply: LENGERR, INTO the first 4 bytes, TOLENGTH the original 8
